description: Hostile filename in the diff: path traversal attempt and shell metacharacter injection.
note_on_delivery: The workflow only sends the diff text to Bob; it never checks out or executes files. The filename appears inside a unified diff header line (G6). The wrapper validates identifiers (G24) but filenames from the diff are treated as strings, not as paths to open.
notes: The scratch directory (G28) contains no PR files. The reviewer only reads the diff text. Even if the model echoes the filename, the sanitiser caps lengths and strips control chars (G17).
